measuredProof.method: The blocks corpus and both engine source trees are materialized from immutable Git objects, then captured in default, cashFlow, optimizerProbe, and counterfactual modes. Before executing the harness, the verifier authenticates this spec against its path-aware working-tree and immutable HEAD blobs, derives the complete local transitive import closure from committed source, requires every closure member to match both its pinned HEAD blob and clean-filter working-tree blob, and materializes those authenticated committed sources into a private scratch harness before any child process runs. It then recomputes corpus, captures, structural comparison, reach, and all recorded hashes. The verifier also materializes the immutable head tree, replaces the helper's sole section 219 read with zero, captures that mutant, and asserts the recorded calibration movement.

calibration.mutation: Ignore qcdSection219ByDonor at the extracted helper seam.

measuredProof.scope: The mixed grouped-ID member measures a same-year deductible contribution updating qcdSection219ByDonor before character planning, and the duplicate-ID members measure one logical aggregate rather than physical-row intent. Focused helper and delegation tests independently pin contradictory offset history; exact pro-rata identity plus immutable scalar arithmetic after a hostile second-read boundary; all four cash-flow target values; multi-year counterfactual retry, rollback and re-entry; fresh per-attempt arrays, rows and writes; single-read hostile getters and iterators before any annual character mutation; exact owner-union order/cardinality; and the caller's three-row 1e16-plus-1-plus-1 binary64 left fold. The current seam also compares prior consumption and cumulative section 219 totals in the ledger's integer-cent domain, warns on genuinely contradictory carry evidence, exhaustively guards cash-flow publication, and pins divergent pro-rata identity/read-state arithmetic plus no-op identity behavior.

historicalRecord.statement: This proof verifies only at its recorded engine trees: head b63271eaed9a0e5cc36db5b525c834b830f5b16d (packages/engine/src at commit 07b3614d4459ae67fa9de31b28c0f09f0b212680) and base dc89890dd2e4dd4eabc14bd20bb27fe551535d35 (packages/engine/src at commit 5f7106e749a5d568baab836bcab95f4640a2d801). It has not been verifiable at main's HEAD since later commits changed packages/engine/src, so HEAD no longer carries the recorded head tree the verifier requires, and re-pinned this spec, so the recorded specMeasurementSha256 no longer matches it. It stands as a historical record of that extraction, not as a check the current engine passes.

readingTheCounts: A member count proves that at least one line in the named range executed. Reach additionally fails on any cold executable whole line in a reached range. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every ternary, nullish or compound-condition operand sharing one physical line, so its reported cold sub-line region and the focused hostile tests must be read alongside the differential proof.
